name: Hazienda
kurzbeschreibung:
**A Hacienda in St. Anton am Arlberg**

Experience the charm of a **Hazienda** in the heart of the **Arlberg** region—where rustic elegance meets alpine adventure. Just steps away from the world-famous ski slopes of **St. Anton am Arlberg**, this refined retreat blends traditional Tyrolean hospitality with modern luxury.

Indulge in gourmet delights like **Kaiserschmarrn** and **Apfelstrudel**, paired with the finest local wines from **Tirol**. Whether you're unwinding after a day on the slopes or exploring the scenic trails of the **Lech Valley**, this haven offers warmth, comfort, and the perfect escape.

Discover why **St. Anton am Arlberg** is more than just a ski destination—it’s a year-round paradise for relaxation and discovery.
